status: Frozen after independent mathematical review and root approval, before implementation, candidate tests or GPU execution.

scope.allowed_generation: Only expansion of manually authored literal color grids/direct integer band predicates to expected packed-byte hashes and original source RGBA byte hashes.

schema.color_palette: Each color is explicit RGB plus alpha 255; clear is 0x00RRGGBB. Source rows and output rows use the same literal palette, but output expansion never samples sources.
schema.float_encoding: JSON ordinary geometry numbers denote exactly representable dyadic/integer f32 values. f32_bits objects denote the exact 32-bit binary payload, with no decimal round trip. Arithmetic oracle is the current Rust f32 operation order; no f64/reciprocal/FMA substitution.
schema.command_index: Zero-based index in that fixture command list, excluding the implicit initial clear.
schema.scalar_lut_cases: May deliberately supply destination coordinates outside visible coverage to unit-check the scalar clamp formula; these are not extra image dispatch pixels.
schema.repeat_patterns: Bounded declarative repetition/fill for planner tests; no expansion or renderer execution was performed for malformed/budget input descriptions.
schema.new_protocol: New PASS buffer/invocation records are not generated from a candidate; final protocol tuples require separate reviewed calculation once storage layout is accepted. Original seven tuples are copied exactly below.
schema.negative_case_assembly: Start with default_frame, one default_valid_source, and one default_image. source replaces source 0; sources_pattern replaces the entire source table. frame/default_frame and document_offset set frame fields. rect/image_source_id replace fields in the default image. commands or commands_pattern replace the command list; suffix is appended after the default image. Hidden expansions inherit the base source/limits and replace commands, with invalid IDs explicitly retained.
schema.positive_boundary_case_assembly: Use the explicit frame/source or sources_pattern and commands/commands_pattern. repeat/sequence descriptions are finite exact lists, expanded only later by an authorized fixture implementation. Source rgba_repeat is an exact four-byte fill, not a renderer-produced image.

strict_source_format.source_ids: u32 index into one prevalidated bounded source table; repeats reference identical bytes
stricter_than_Canvas: Canvas skips zero-sized or undersized sources; this probe rejects them.
Canvas permits unused trailing RGBA bytes; this probe requires exact length.
Canvas supports transparent/translucent image blending; this probe rejects alpha other than 255 even when hidden.
Probe rejects unsupported whole streams instead of preserving partial Canvas painting after a limit.

limits.cpu_source_validation: Check source count and checked aggregate exact lengths before scans/allocations; validate and pack each declared source once; do not rescan a shared source per draw.
limits.cpu_lut_work: At most visible width+height once per image draw, with cumulative count/byte preflight. The 143360 bound is derived from 256*(320+240), not an independently reachable success input under tighter limits.
limits.exclusions: No claim about driver/staging allocations, process peak memory, hard driver teardown bound, browser integration or performance.
